entities.summary: Bologna Cathedral, formally known as the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Peter, is the cathedral of Bologna, Italy, and the seat of the Archbishop of Bologna. Dedicated to Saint Peter, most of the present structure dates to the 17th century, with some parts dating back to the late 16th century.
